name: Mr Holiday Houdini
author: CherrimPlushie
description: Move up between the cube portal and spike at 39% and then play through the slopes as the wave. Spam between the cube portal and spike at 41%, get the mini portal and then hold above the level between the hitboxes at 42%. Stay slightly above the gameplay until 92% where you can fall back into the level and then have to spam through the red orbs while moving slightly upward until 94% where after you passed all the orbs and saws, you can stop spamming.
